task_definition.task_description: Check Alice Smith's availability for October 24th, 2024, then look up the Hilton Tokyo and book a standard room for her from October 24th to the 28th. After that, check the weather alerts for Tokyo, archive the weather report as a high-priority "Destination Weather Archive" for Alice, and finally send her a notification that it has been archived.

user_input.query: Could you please check the schedule for calendar user u_alice to see if Alice Smith is available on 2024-10-24? Then, look up the Hilton Tokyo and book a standard room for her from 2024-10-24 to 2024-10-28. Once the booking is sorted, check the current weather alerts for Tokyo. Please save that weather report as a high-priority "Destination Weather Archive" for Alice. Finally, send a message to my contact alice to notify her that the weather report has been archived.
